| **6 validations instead of 3** | Cross-product batching: `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` and `%(ValidationRule.Filename)` in the same task batches on the cartesian product | Batch only on `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` and use `@(ValidationRule->'%(Filename)', ', ')` transform to reference all rules |
| **CS2002 duplicate warnings** | `<Compile Include="**\*.g.cs">` duplicates SDK's implicit glob; target also re-adds | Changed to `<Compile Update="**\*.g.cs">` to set metadata without re-including |
| **Clean removes too many / wrong files** | `FileWrites` in a static ItemGroup isn't tracked by incremental clean properly | Moved `FileWrites` inside the target where files are actually created |
| **Generated files not tracked** | The `CleanGeneratedCode` target only removed Compile items, didn't delete files | Removed it — proper `FileWrites` registration means `dotnet clean` handles deletion automatically |
